question: At one fixed requested node budget on fresh positions, how fast are active Leviathan and the lossless P01 stack relative to the frozen official Stockfish parent?

design.corpus_generation: Frozen parent, seed 2026081613, 2,000 nodes/move, seeded weighted choice among top three, two positions from each of 25 games
design.exactness: A/A parent transcripts and active-reference/P01 transcripts must match exactly. Parent and active behavior are expected to differ and are never called lossless.

interpretation_guard: This resolves parent-relative fixed-node throughput only. It is neither a lossless parent-relative optimization claim nor strength evidence.
